items.source: Can be used natively, declaring several nested Scheduled annotations. Can also be used in conjunction with Java 8's support for repeatable annotations, where Scheduled can simply be declared several times on the same method, implicitly generating this container annotation.
items.translation: 可以原生使用，声明多个嵌套的Scheduled注解。 也可以与 Java 8 对可重复注解的支持配合使用，此时可以在同一方法上多次声明Scheduled，从而隐式生成该容器注解。

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations.
items.translation: 此注解可用作 元注解 来创建自定义的 组合注解。
